lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Li12Fe2O24 (reduced formula BaLi6FeO12) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over 10 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li and Ba adopt both octahedral and higher-coordinate O environments. Corner-sharing between FeO6 and LiO6 octahedra, and edge-sharing between BaO6 and LiO6 polyhedra, is observed in the validated polyhedral contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
